1. Each user must have at least one role
2. Assets can only be assigned to active employees
3. Maintenance records must reference valid assets
4. Asset assignments must have valid date ranges
5. Audit logs are immutable (no updates/deletes allowed)
6. Soft delete pattern used for most entities (is_active flag)
7. All timestamps use TIMESTAMPTZ for timezone awareness
8. Serial numbers must be unique across all assets
